definition.name: Go runtime and complete capsule qualification

steps.name: Capture immutable qualification source inputs
steps.run:
git archive --format=tar.gz --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-source.tar.gz" HEAD -- \
  apps sdk/go-guest sdk/rust examples tools crates wit schemas docs .cargo \
  Cargo.toml Cargo.lock rust-toolchain.toml LICENSE NOTICE .github/workflows/go-guest.yml
test "$(stat --format=%s "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-source.tar.gz")" -le 134217728
git rev-parse HEAD > "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-source.sha"

steps.name: Retain the exact reviewed command contract input
Install the locked compiler and generator
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
cargo install --git https://github.com/bytecodealliance/componentize-go --rev 148dba505f8c6c64ad84db777cfde5e34e25098b --locked componentize-go
test "$(wasm-tools --version | cut -d ' ' -f 1,2)" = 'wasm-tools 1.254.0'
mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
curl --fail --location --max-time 180 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go.tbz" https://github.com/dicej/go/releases/download/go1.27.1-wasi-on-idle/go-linux-amd64-bootstrap.tbz
echo "4b4fcbbab5b5b0a45433112aa51c64a54007b24f1efd05b67018ca2cf8633e2c  $RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go.tbz" | sha256sum --check --strict
tar -xjf "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go.tbz" -C "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
echo "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools/go-linux-amd64-bootstrap/bin" >> "$GITHUB_PATH"

steps.name: Retain pinned reproduction tools
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
out="$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-tools"
cp "$HOME/.cargo/bin/componentize-go" "$(command -v wasm-tools)" "$out/"
sha256sum "$out/componentize-go" "$out/wasm-tools" > "$out/tools.sha256"

steps.name: Generate and compile upstream and constrained LSF components
Qualify proposed transaction shapes and explicit owners with the maintained Go compiler
Execute the compiled runtime diagnostic without claiming admission
steps.run:
set -o pipefail
cargo --config .cargo/managed-guest.toml run --locked -p latent-wasmtime --example go_runtime_probe -- "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-probe/lsf-candidate.wasm" 2>&1 | tee "$RUNNER_TEMP/go-guest-probe/runtime-diagnostic.log"

steps.name: Check standalone project source boundaries and closed provenance
steps.run:
python3 -m pip install -r tools/requirements.lock
python3 -m unittest tools.tests.test_go_capsule_authoring tools.tests.test_build_provenance_schemas

steps.name: Qualify editable projects, all SDK owners, enforced node and printed guide
Retain successful and failed upstream observations
